r.경제 체제: Economy transformed by oil · gold, rice, sugar
r.생활 물가 수준: 47% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.한국이 파는 것: Excavators and construction machinery 54%, Other machinery, computers 25%, Electronics, electrical equipment 5%, Coated steel sheet 4% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Crude oil 94%, Copper 3%, Electronics, electrical equipment 2%, Aluminum 1% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: A presidential system in which two parties, rooted in the Indian-descended and African-descended communities, face off.

t.why: Huge offshore oil discoveries since 2015 have made its economy the fastest-growing in the world. Venezuela claims two-thirds of its territory.
t.rel: Venezuela claims the Essequibo region, two-thirds of its territory. Huge offshore oil discoveries since 2015 have made its economy grow fast.
t.know: The only South American country with English as its official language.
t.etext: Since oil production began at offshore fields in 2019, it has become the world's fastest-growing economy. It also sells gold, rice and sugar. How to share the oil money is the big challenge.
